text.arabic_uthmani: لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ

words.gloss_range: fronted benefactive prepositional phrase assigning the coming benefits to the addressed group

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: container phrase paired with the opening beneficiary phrase

words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) makes the clause start with the beneficiaries before the benefit noun appears. The addressees are grammatically present as recipients, not as actors in the later destination movement, and the fronting keeps entitlement to benefit distinct from the later endpoint at the House. Its fused preposition-plus-pronoun form also pairs with {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}), so the opening frame gives both for whom and where before naming what is available.

topics.headline: recipient before benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first places the addressees inside a benefactive frame before it names the benefits.
topics.reason: The word is a preposition with a second-person plural suffix and belongs to the fronted predicate frame governing the delayed benefit noun.

topics.headline: benefit not endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader separates the addressees' use of the animals from the animals' later ritual endpoint.
topics.reason: Local syntax links the benefactive phrase to the benefit clause, while the later endpoint phrase is governed separately after {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}).

topics.headline: paired pronoun frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening as a compact two-part frame: beneficiary first, container second.
topics.reason: The opening prepositional form is immediately followed by another preposition-plus-pronoun form, producing a compact recipient-container setup.

words.gloss_range: prepositional pronoun phrase locating the benefits in the prior feminine antecedent

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fronted beneficiary phrase before the container phrase

words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) keeps the benefits inside the previously mentioned animals or signs rather than presenting them as external add-ons. The feminine suffix makes 22:33 continue the referent from 22:32, while the preposition makes utility embedded in that referent. Because the appointed-term phrase follows, that containment is also heard within a period of availability, not as timeless possession. After {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}), the phrase completes the opening frame: for you, in them, benefits.

topics.headline: benefits contained in antecedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the benefits are presented as inherent in the prior referent, not merely attached from outside.
topics.reason: The preposition governs a feminine suffix and locates the benefit noun through the local prepositional frame.

topics.headline: suffix continues 22:32
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 22:33 as a continuation of the venerated signs in 22:32 rather than a new isolated statement.
topics.reason: The bound feminine suffix requires an antecedent and aligns with the previous ayah's referential flow.

topics.headline: for whom, where, what
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the clause in ordered stages: recipient, container, then benefit.
topics.reason: The two fronted prepositional phrases precede the delayed nominative benefit noun in the local nominal clause.

topics.headline: availability within a period
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear containment alongside duration because the next phrase limits the benefits to an appointed term.
topics.reason: The local preposition primarily locates benefits in the antecedent, while the following {{ar:إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ}} ({{tr:ilā ajalin}}) phrase supplies the temporal boundary.

words.gloss_range: open plural benefits or useful yields assigned to the addressees and embedded in the prior referent
words.root_gloss_range: benefiting, availing, usefulness, profit, and tangible utility; locally realized as plural available benefits with a temporal limit

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: appointed-term phrase that bounds the benefits

words.prose: {{ar:مَنَٰفِعُ}} ({{tr:manāfiʿu}}) arrives only after the ayah has fixed the recipient and container, so the benefits are already framed as for the addressees and in the prior animals or signs. Its indefinite broken plural keeps the benefit field open: tangible uses and useful yields are affirmed without being itemized. That openness is not unlimited, because the next phrase {{ar:إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّۭى}} ({{tr:ilā ajalin musamman}}) turns the benefits into availability for a fixed period; the same benefit wording also links back to pilgrimage benefit language in 22:28. The wider benefit-harm background stays secondary, since this local word selects the positive side of availment.

topics.headline: benefit named after its frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that benefit is not introduced bare; recipient, container, and term frame it.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative and delayed after two fronted prepositional phrases, with a later endpoint complement attached through {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}).

topics.headline: open plural utility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees multiple useful yields affirmed without a closed inventory of what counts as benefit.
topics.reason: The local form is an indefinite plural abstract noun, and the root range supports benefit, availment, and practical usefulness.

topics.headline: benefits until a term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from open benefit to finite availability.
topics.reason: The benefits are followed by an endpoint phrase, so the grammar affirms usefulness while limiting duration.

topics.headline: open benefits, fixed House
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees benefit-types left open while the destination later becomes definite and known.
topics.reason: The benefit noun is indefinite, while the later House phrase is definite and adjectivally specified.

topics.headline: same-surah benefit thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this benefit statement to the pilgrimage benefit frame already sounded in 22:28.
topics.reason: The repeated noun form supports a same-surah echo with 22:28, while the local sense remains the benefits available in the animals or signs.

topics.headline: benefit as evaluated utility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats benefit as real availment, while no local harm contrast is asserted in this ayah.
topics.reason: The broader benefit-harm binary is valid root background, but no local word in 22:33 activates a direct harm contrast.

words.gloss_range: endpoint preposition marking the temporal limit of the benefit period

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later spatial endpoint particle mirroring the first temporal endpoint particle

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) turns the open benefits into benefits up to a term. It does not merely place the benefits somewhere in time; it sends them toward a terminus, and the governed phrase that follows makes that boundary explicit. This first endpoint particle also prepares the later {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}), where the ayah repeats the endpoint logic but shifts from time to place.

topics.headline: benefit period has an endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah grants benefits only up to a temporal boundary.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:أَجَلٍ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}), and the attachment evidence identifies the role as a temporal endpoint.

topics.headline: visible endpoint phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the benefit first and then the explicit boundary that restricts it.
topics.reason: Unlike the earlier suffixed prepositions, this particle opens a separate governed phrase after the benefit noun.

topics.headline: first endpoint mirror
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's architecture: the first endpoint is temporal, the second endpoint is spatial.
topics.reason: The same endpoint particle appears later before the House, creating a local repetition across two domains.

words.gloss_range: an appointed term or deadline functioning as the temporal endpoint of the benefits
words.root_gloss_range: term, deadline, appointed time, duration, respite, or lifespan; locally the bounded use-period before destination

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: specified adjective that designates the term

words.prose: {{ar:أَجَلٍۢ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}) gives the benefit period its boundary. The word is indefinite on the surface, so the date is not disclosed to the reader, but its adjective {{ar:مُّسَمًّۭى}} ({{tr:musamman}}) makes the term designated rather than vague. For the animals' utility, that boundary functions as a permitted use-period with an expiry, while the word itself remains general term-language. The exact phrase {{ar:إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّۭى}} ({{tr:ilā ajalin musamman}}) also repeats 22:5, drawing biological duration and ritual duration into the same term-formula.

topics.headline: deadline for benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the benefits are scheduled, not open-ended.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}), making it the temporal terminus of the benefit phrase.

topics.headline: unspecified yet fixed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the term can be real and appointed even though its exact timing is not stated.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite but is immediately qualified by a passive participle meaning specified or appointed.

topics.headline: permitted use period
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears animal utility as a permitted use-period with an expiry, while the word itself remains general term-language.
topics.reason: The local phrase licenses bounded duration and legal-ritual scheduling, but it does not require a debt-contract sense as the selected translation.

topics.headline: boundary as noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary as a standing term rather than an action of postponing.
topics.reason: The local word is an abstract noun in a prepositional endpoint phrase, not a passive form naming something deferred.

topics.headline: recognized term formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this appointed-term phrase to the same formula in 22:5.
topics.reason: The pairing of the term noun with the specified participle is recurrent, and the exact phrase appears earlier in the surah at 22:5.

topics.headline: term centers the beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the term as the hinge that disciplines the benefit root.
topics.reason: The root appears here in nominal term language and directly constrains the preceding benefit phrase.

words.gloss_range: specified, designated, appointed; passive qualifier of the term
words.root_gloss_range: naming, designation, distinguishing, and elevation; locally narrowed to passive specification of a temporal term

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: term noun qualified by the passive participle

words.prose: {{ar:مُّسَمًّۭى}} ({{tr:musamman}}) seals the temporal phrase by making the term assigned, not merely possible. It agrees with {{ar:أَجَلٍ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}), so the specification belongs to the term rather than to the benefits themselves. The root dispute around naming and elevation can enrich the sense of a term raised out of anonymity, but the local Form II passive participle keeps the selected force at designated or appointed. That assigned interval brings the practical benefits under a named schedule, and the same participle links the phrase back to 22:5.

topics.headline: modifier completes the term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the term is completed as a specified endpoint, not left as generic duration.
topics.reason: The participle functions adjectivally and agrees with the preceding term noun.

topics.headline: fixed without disclosed date
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a term that is formally unspecified to them yet still designated.
topics.reason: The adjective is indefinite and genitive by agreement, preserving the surface indefiniteness of the term while marking it as specified.

topics.headline: assigned not self-named
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint is fixed by designation rather than discovered by the users of the benefits.
topics.reason: The local form is a Form II passive participle, so the term receives specification.

topics.headline: naming raised from anonymity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel designation as a term singled out from vagueness, while the local sense remains specified or appointed.
topics.reason: The broader root field supports naming and elevation imagery, but the local passive participle does not select a literal sky or rising sense.

topics.headline: formula prepares next stage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the specified term as the point from which {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) can move to the next ritual stage.
topics.reason: The appointed-term formula recurs in 22:5 and stands immediately before the transition particle in 22:33.

topics.headline: named interval governs benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the practical benefits of the animals brought under a named schedule.
topics.reason: The participle completes the term phrase that limits the benefit noun.

words.gloss_range: sequential conjunction moving from the completed time-bound benefit clause to the later destination clause
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) carries the ayah's main turn. After the appointed term has been sealed, it introduces the whole destination clause, not just the next noun, so the benefit period and the place-of-fulfillment stage do not collapse into one. Because it carries no suffix or governed complement, the small conjunction works as a pure hinge: time turns into sequence and then into place.

topics.headline: from term to destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destination follows the benefit period rather than overlapping it.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the first nominal clause to the later nominal clause and marks delayed sequence.

topics.headline: conjunction scopes over clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the benefit-period clause and the endpoint clause distinct.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies a second nominal clause after the conjunction.

topics.headline: small word, large turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a compressed hinge where useful availability gives way to decisive ritual destination.
topics.reason: The conjunction is an unattached function word, yet it carries the structural turn between the two clauses.

topics.headline: pure clause connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word work as a clause hinge without adding a new pronoun or governed complement.
topics.reason: The word is a conjunction with no attached suffix or complement.

words.gloss_range: their place or time of release, fulfillment, or lawful endpoint
words.root_gloss_range: untying, release, alighting, becoming lawful, and resolution; locally concentrated in a noun of place/time for the animals' ritual endpoint

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: transition particle before the endpoint clause
destination phrase directing the endpoint to the House

words.prose: {{ar:مَحِلُّهَآ}} ({{tr:maḥilluhā}}) opens the second nominal clause as the animals' own endpoint. The suffix carries the same referent across {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}), so the things that held benefits are the same things now brought to their place of fulfillment. The noun-of-place/time form gathers release, arrival, and lawfulness into a local endpoint, then the following {{ar:إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ}} ({{tr:ilā al-bayti}}) directs that endpoint to the House; this fixes ritual geography in a way that also recalls the House-place frame of 22:26. The lawfulness field echoes the same root in 22:30.

topics.headline: endpoint clause subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the destination clause as a standing assertion, not a new finite action.
topics.reason: The word is nominative and begins the second nominal clause whose predicate is the following destination phrase.

topics.headline: same referent reaches endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one referent from contained benefits to ritual endpoint.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix matches the earlier suffixed reference and binds the endpoint to the same animals or signs.

topics.headline: endpoint belongs to them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint is not generic; it is their endpoint.
topics.reason: The construct-like suffix relation makes the noun definite without an article.

topics.headline: release and lawfulness localized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the endpoint as a place where arrival, release, and lawful fulfillment converge.
topics.reason: The noun-of-place/time form licenses a local endpoint, while broader root branches are kept as converging pressure rather than separate selected senses.

topics.headline: noun of place or time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names the locus of fulfillment rather than merely the act of release.
topics.reason: The aligned form tag identifies a noun of time/place, and the contextual profile marks this exact form as rare.

topics.headline: lawfulness field in passage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the endpoint to nearby lawfulness language in 22:30 without turning the House into a mere legal abstraction.
topics.reason: The same root appears in 22:30, and lawfulness is a valid root branch, but the local word remains a place/time noun directed to a concrete destination.

topics.headline: release directed to House
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ritual geography become concrete as the release-place points to the House, with 22:26 as a nearby geography frame.
topics.reason: The noun immediately takes a destination phrase to the House, and the supplied inter-ayah relation links local ritual geography with 22:26.

topics.headline: term hands off to release
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from a specified time limit to concrete ritual release.
topics.reason: The specified term precedes {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}), which then introduces the endpoint noun.

words.gloss_range: spatial endpoint preposition directing the endpoint relation to the House

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: endpoint noun directed by the spatial preposition
earlier temporal endpoint particle mirrored by the spatial endpoint particle

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) makes the House the endpoint toward which {{ar:مَحِلُّهَآ}} ({{tr:maḥilluhā}}) points. It is not a bare locative marker; it gives the second clause a destination predicate. Because the ayah already used {{ar:إِلَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) for the appointed term, the repetition forms an endpoint refrain: first time, then place.

topics.headline: House as endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the House is a destination, not merely a location where something happens.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the House noun and functions as the predicate complement for the endpoint noun.

topics.headline: destination named separately
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the destination stated as a full phrase after the endpoint subject.
topics.reason: The particle is independent and introduces a governed noun phrase rather than being absorbed into a suffix.

topics.headline: time-place endpoint mirror
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated endpoint particle binding temporal limit and spatial destination.
topics.reason: The same preposition governs the temporal term earlier and the spatial House phrase here.

words.gloss_range: the known House, the concrete sacred structure serving as the spatial endpoint
words.root_gloss_range: house, dwelling, lodging-place, shelter, and by extension container; locally narrowed to the definite concrete House, the Kaaba
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَيْتِ}} ({{tr:al-bayti}}) gives the endpoint a known concrete destination. Its definiteness assumes the recognized ritual House, and the following adjective completes the title as {{ar:ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ}} ({{tr:al-bayti al-ʿatīqi}}). Broader dwelling and container imagery can make the endpoint feel settled rather than abstract, but the local selected sense is the concrete House, not a night-planning action and not the separate verse-container branch as a local meaning; the exact phrase also repeats 22:29 and sits in the pilgrimage geography already marked in 22:26.

topics.headline: known concrete endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the destination as one known sacred structure, not an unspecified house.
topics.reason: The noun is singular, definite with the article, and the QAC grammar identifies it as referring to the Kaaba.

topics.headline: governed endpoint noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the House is grammatically governed as the destination and heads the final adjective phrase.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}), and the final adjective agrees with it.

topics.headline: Ancient House phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the endpoint as the completed title {{ar:ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ}} ({{tr:al-bayti al-ʿatīqi}}), not just a bare noun.
topics.reason: The following definite adjective specifies the House and forms a constrained phrase with it.

topics.reason: The verse-container branch is part of the wider root range, while the local form and grammar select the concrete sacred structure.

topics.headline: not night-action

topics.reason: The local form is a definite concrete noun, not a verbal form from the night-planning branch.

topics.headline: release directed to House
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the House as the place toward which the release or lawfulness endpoint is directed.
topics.reason: The House is the governed destination of {{ar:مَحِلُّهَآ}} ({{tr:maḥilluhā}}).

topics.headline: phrase reprises 22:29
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this endpoint phrase with the same House formula in 22:29 and the House geography of 22:26.
topics.reason: The exact phrase recurs in 22:29, and the wider same-surah geography includes the House reference in 22:26.

words.gloss_range: ancient, venerable, freed; here the definite qualifying adjective of the House
words.root_gloss_range: old, ancient, noble through age, freed or emancipated; locally concentrated in the fixed House title

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: complete definite House title sealed by the adjective

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَتِيقِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿatīqi}}) closes the ayah by specifying the House's defining quality. Its agreement keeps it inside the governed destination phrase, and its definiteness makes the final words sound like a fixed title. The adjective carries ancient and venerable force, with a freed or emancipated undertone, but all of that is narrowed into the constrained phrase {{ar:ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ}} ({{tr:al-bayti al-ʿatīqi}}), repeated with 22:29 and rare in the supplied evidence.

topics.reason: The adjective matches the definite House noun and forms a constrained pair with it.

topics.headline: freed force within title

topics.reason: The root range includes freeing and manumission, but the local adjective modifies the House rather than naming an independent act of emancipation.

topics.headline: rare repeated formula

topics.reason: The contextual evidence marks the adjective as rare and confined to this House formula in the supplied data.

topics.headline: 22:29 reprise at the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the ayah's closing title to the same phrase in 22:29.
topics.reason: The same House title occurs in 22:29 and returns here at the end of 22:33.

topics.headline: final word closure

topics.reason: The adjective is postposed after the House noun and is the final word of the ayah.

topics.reason: The exact adjective form is tied to the House phrase in the supplied occurrence evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence مَنَٰفِعُ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَا إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Usable value is granted for a bounded, publicly designated interval; ثُمَّ closes that tenure, and مَحِلُّهَا combines arrival at a place with the falling-due of an obligation. The enduring House receives what can no longer remain merely available for use.

activation_trace.role: The harm-opposed benefit image establishes usable value as the first phase.
The fixed temporal limit makes that usefulness a tenure rather than an unrestricted possession.
Naming as designation makes the limit identifiable and authorized.
Arrival and settling at a place supplies the spatial side of the terminal transition.
The coming-due of a right or offering supplies the obligatory side of the same transition.
The shelter or dwelling image turns the destination into a receiving center.
Deep temporal rootedness distinguishes the receiving House from the temporary utility phase.

changed_reading.before: The objects are useful for a while and later go to a venerable house.
changed_reading.after: The ayah regulates a two-stage tenure: benefit remains available only until a named deadline, when settlement and due-ness transfer the object to the enduring House.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coupling of أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى with مَحِلُّهَا إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet's alternate و س م inventory lets مُّسَمًّى activate a marked season at which people gather. On this reading the limit is not an abstract date but a socially legible season that collects dispersed benefits and directs them toward one House.

activation_trace.role: Benefit supplies the dispersed utilities that the marked season coordinates.
A fixed limit gives the assembly a bounded temporal station.
The marked season and gathering image turns the appointed term into a public rendezvous.
Settling at a place converts temporal convergence into spatial convergence.
The House is the common receiving shelter around which the season gathers.

changed_reading.before: مُّسَمًّى merely says that the deadline has a specified date.
changed_reading.after: The deadline can also be heard as a marked public season that gathers separate uses and users into a common arrival at the House.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The turn from مَنَٰفِعُ to مَحِلُّهَا and the qualification ٱلْعَتِيقِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The useful object first sits inside human instrumentality. At the term, the حل images of untying and release from restriction join the عتق image of emancipation, so the endpoint is a release from being held indefinitely as an asset.

activation_trace.role: Benefit names the object's initial availability to human use.
The time limit prevents that availability from becoming permanent.
Untying a knot supplies the image of release from the utility phase.
Release from a restriction supplies the legal change accompanying the physical release.
Emancipation makes the House an endpoint characterized by freedom from ownership.
The shelter image gives the released object a positive destination rather than mere disposal.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint simply terminates a period of practical use.
changed_reading.after: The endpoint releases the object from indefinite instrumentality and delivers it into the freedom-associated shelter of the House.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact temporal construction in 22:5 sits inside a process of holding in wombs, reaching the appointed term, emerging, and attaining maturity. That sequence revises the focus deadline from passive waiting into protected custody ordered toward a due emergence and destination.

activation_trace.role: The focus's fixed limit is the temporal hinge being revised.
The focus arrival supplies the post-custody destination.
Fixing and stabilizing supplies the protected holding phase before the deadline.
The female womb gives that holding phase a concrete developmental container.
The same fixed temporal limit links the developmental sequence directly to the focus wording.
The same designation image marks the developmental threshold as an appointed one.
Passage to the outside supplies the directional arrow after the appointed holding period.
Reaching a goal makes emergence part of an ordered maturation rather than an arbitrary cutoff.

structural_cues: 22:5 places إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ between stabilization in wombs and being brought out.
Both 22:5 and 22:33 use the named term as a hinge in a staged process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared construction plus custody, emergence, and maturation; I transfer that process-shape to the focus objects. The live alternative is that the repeated phrase contributes only a generic deadline, not a developmental analogy.

changed_reading.before: The named term is merely the last day on which benefits may be taken.
changed_reading.after: The term is a guarded maturation threshold: benefits occur inside a temporary custody whose proper completion is release into the appointed destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 22:12-13 benefit is not self-authenticating: it is tested against harm and against the nearness of the relation producing it. This makes the focus's benefits ethically relational; their term and destination keep utility from becoming an ultimate allegiance.

activation_trace.role: The focus's harm-opposed benefit is the anchor whose value is being tested.
Negated benefit shows that a claimed object of reliance may fail the utility test.
Harm as benefit's contrary makes utility an explicit discriminating axis.
The repeated contrary becomes relationally dominant rather than merely possible.
Nearness ranks competing outcomes and makes benefit depend on the relation one approaches.
Benefit reappears as the subordinated side of that comparison.

structural_cues: 22:12 coordinates what neither harms nor benefits; 22:13 then says harm is nearer than benefit.
The focus immediately binds its benefits to a limit and a House-directed endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit benefit-harm-nearness test; I infer that the focus's utility is legitimate because it remains subordinate to its named destination. The alternative is a strictly material sense with no carryover from the earlier polemic.

changed_reading.before: مَنَٰفِعُ is a neutral inventory of practical gains.
changed_reading.after: The benefits are relationally judged goods: valid utility is utility that does not replace the orientation toward its due destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The local sequence makes the House equally available to resident and visitor, sends travelers toward it, has them witness benefits, feeds the needy, completes vows, and culminates in circumambulation. The focus therefore compresses a circulation system: benefits are witnessed and redistributed before the common House coordinates completion.

activation_trace.role: The focus benefit anchors the material that circulates through the sequence.
The receiving shelter anchors the common center of circulation.
The time-rooted House supplies continuity across repeated public arrivals.
Equality between two parties makes access to the center nonexclusive.
The repeated House as shelter ties prepared place and receiving center together.
Presence with direct witnessing makes benefits public events rather than private abstractions.
The exact benefit root links the witnessed gains to the focus.
Feeding another converts benefit into outward distribution.
Need and lack identify a recipient for the distributed benefit.
Completion without deficiency makes fulfillment part of the terminal phase.
Circling around a center makes the House an active organizer of motion.
The same shelter image identifies the center around which completion moves.
The repeated ancientness confirms that this is the focus's named destination.

structural_cues: 22:25 declares the sanctuary equal for resident and visitor.
22:27-29 moves from arrival, to witnessed benefits and feeding, to fulfillment and circumambulation.
22:28, 22:29, and 22:33 repeat the focus roots for benefits and the Ancient House.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equal access, incoming movement, witnessed benefit, feeding, fulfillment, and circling; I connect them as one circulation mechanism summarized by 22:33. The alternative is that these are adjacent but independent pilgrimage acts.

changed_reading.before: The benefits belong primarily to the immediate owners until an endpoint at the House.
changed_reading.after: The benefits participate in a public circuit of witnessing, nourishment, fulfillment, and equal access whose coordinating center is the Ancient House.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:30 places the making-lawful of livestock inside a sentence about magnifying inviolable limits and preserving exceptions. This activates the legal-state branch of مَحِلُّهَا: benefits are licensed uses, not proof of unrestricted ownership, and the deadline moves the livestock into its due disposition.

activation_trace.role: The focus benefit is recast as a permitted use rather than an absolute title.
Release from prohibition supplies the legal-state dimension of the focus endpoint.
The falling-due of a right makes legal availability terminate in obligation.
Inviolability and protected right bound the surrounding grant of use.
The explicit release from prohibition identifies livestock utility as legally granted.
The livestock-wealth image identifies the material class whose lawful use is bounded.

structural_cues: 22:30 joins magnifying inviolable limits, livestock made lawful, explicit exceptions, and commands of avoidance.
22:33 gives benefits a temporal limit before مَحِلُّهَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lawful livestock within protected limits; I infer that the focus's utility is a revocable legal permission that matures into a due claim. The alternative is that حلال in 22:30 and محل in 22:33 remain semantically separate.

changed_reading.before: Having benefits implies broad control over the useful animals until sacrifice.
changed_reading.after: The benefits are a bounded license inside an inviolable order; usefulness never cancels the due claim that takes effect at the term.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:31 depicts uncontrolled motion: falling, being snatched, being driven by wind, and ending in a remote place. Against that sequence, the focus's named term and repeated إِلَى create a controlled vector whose stable terminus is the House.

activation_trace.role: Settling at a place anchors controlled arrival.
A shelter supplies the stable terminus opposed to dispersal.
Temporal rootedness makes the destination durable rather than accidental.
Noisy, unstable falling supplies the first form of unguided motion.
Rapid seizure interrupts agency and fractures the trajectory.
Falling into an abyss extends the image of destination without orientation.
Wind supplies the external force that carries the fallen object away.
Extreme distance supplies the anti-destination against which the House stands.

structural_cues: 22:31 ends with uncontrolled movement into مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ.
22:33 instead uses a named interval, ثُمَّ, and إِلَى twice before naming the House.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two adjacent motion grammars; I read the second as a stabilizing reversal of the first. The alternative is that 22:31's fall concerns only belief and has no spatial activation for 22:33.

changed_reading.before: The House is simply the stated endpoint of a ritual itinerary.
changed_reading.after: The House is the anti-scatter terminus: named timing and due settlement rescue motion from seizure, drift, and remote dissipation.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:32 identifies the relevant signs as marks whose magnification arises from protective piety in the heart; 22:36 then identifies the sacrificial bodies themselves among those signs. The focus benefits therefore occur inside a sign-bearing trust: utility must preserve, not consume, the object's capacity to complete its marked rite.

activation_trace.role: Practical benefit is the use that must be subordinated to sign-bearing stewardship.
A visible identifying mark makes the appointed threshold part of the sign mechanism.
A marking sign and ritual token gives the useful object a representational status beyond utility.
Protection from harm turns reverence into active custodial restraint.
The inner core locates the motive that governs outward handling.
The dedicated sacrificial body identifies the concrete bearer of the sign.
The repeated ritual-sign image explicitly places that body in the marked category.

structural_cues: 22:32 locates magnification of the signs in the piety of hearts.
22:36 calls the sacrificial bodies signs and again says they contain good for the addressees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies useful bodies that are also ritual signs; I infer a stewardship rule in which permissible benefit cannot erase their terminal sign-function. The alternative is that sign-reverence and economic use coexist without one constraining the other.

changed_reading.before: The animals first supply benefits and only later acquire ritual significance.
changed_reading.after: They remain sign-bearing trusts throughout the benefit phase, so the deadline protects their capacity to reach the rite for which they are marked.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:34 names a sacrificial rite; 22:36 then stages the bodies until their sides fall, after which eating and feeding begin; 22:37 denies that flesh or blood reaches God and makes piety the true reaching element. This activates مَحِلُّهَا as a due event that converts privately usable life into shared provision and moral reach.

activation_trace.role: The focus benefit supplies the pre-terminal use phase.
The coming-due of an offering supplies the focus hinge into terminal disposition.
The sacrificial offering identifies the type of due event being staged.
Falling and coming to rest gives the due event a visible bodily threshold.
Fixity and obligation resonate with the focus branch of a right becoming due.
Feeding others converts the completed body into outwardly shared benefit.
Contentment identifies one social posture among the recipients.
Presenting oneself or coming to seek identifies another route by which benefit reaches recipients.
Being made tractable for a purpose frames the whole utility-to-rite process as directed service.
The paired delivery image distinguishes what does not reach God materially from what reaches morally.
Literal flesh supplies one material whose divine delivery is explicitly denied.
Literal blood supplies the second material whose divine delivery is explicitly denied.
Protective piety names the nonmaterial result that truly reaches.

structural_cues: 22:34 assigns a sacrificial rite over provision from livestock.
22:36 repeats a benefit formula, then uses فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا as the threshold for eating and feeding.
22:37 reverses the apparent direction of delivery: flesh and blood do not reach God, but piety does.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rite, a bodily fall, distribution, and a corrected reach relation; I align the focus's حلول الوجوب branch with that threshold and treat the House as the institutional endpoint of conversion. The alternative is that مَحِلُّهَا denotes only slaughter location.

changed_reading.before: At the deadline the useful animal is delivered as material to the House.
changed_reading.after: At the due event, utility changes form: the body falls into shared nourishment, while the offering's Godward reach lies in piety rather than transferred flesh or blood.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:40 links expulsion from homes to a counterforce that prevents worship buildings from being demolished. This activates the freedom branch of عَتِيقِ and the shelter branch of بَيْت: the destination is a protected common refuge whose freedom must be maintained against exclusion and destruction.

activation_trace.role: The shelter image anchors the House as refuge.
Emancipation supplies the House's freedom from coercive possession.
Forced passage outside supplies the social wound that a protected refuge reverses.
Belonging to a dwelling makes the expulsion specifically a loss of settled home.
Driving away harm supplies the protective counterforce that keeps worship space open.
The collapse of buildings names the material threat from which sacred shelters require defense.
Places of worship broaden the protected-House mechanism beyond private residence.

structural_cues: 22:40 moves from people expelled from their dwellings to the threatened demolition of multiple worship structures.
The focus calls its receiving shelter عَتِيق, whose inventory includes freedom from bondage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displacement, defended access, and worship buildings; I infer that the focus's freedom-qualified House is a paradigmatic protected refuge. The alternative is that 22:40 states a general defense principle without modifying عَتِيق.

changed_reading.before: The Ancient House is old, noble, and ritually central.
changed_reading.after: The Free House is also an anti-displacement refuge: its ritual centrality depends on defended access and freedom from coercive capture.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:47 opposes human hastening and counting to a promise that does not miss its appointment; 22:48 gives delay a ثُمَّ and an eventual destination; 22:76 closes with all matters returned. The focus deadline is therefore firm but not owner-controlled, and its local Houseward arrival can echo a larger grammar of return without being equated with it.

activation_trace.role: The fixed limit anchors the question of certainty and temporal scale.
Coming due supplies the event whose timing cannot be forced by beneficiaries.
Hastening and bringing forward supplies the human attempt to control the deadline.
A promise failing at its appointed time is explicitly negated, making due time reliable.
A promise bounded by time or place gives the deadline covenantal force.
A span of time whose scale shifts destabilizes purely human measurement.
Counting supplies the human metric that the verse relativizes.
Extended time and respite supplies a long benefit-like interval before reckoning.
Becoming toward an ultimate outcome echoes the focus's directional terminal clause.
Return to what matters came from supplies the surah-wide completion of the destination grammar.

structural_cues: 22:47 says the promise will not fail while contrasting a divine day with human counting.
22:48 has respite, then seizure, then إِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ.
22:76 ends with وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reliable appointment, divergent temporal scale, delay-then-destination, and return; I let that grammar deepen the focus deadline while keeping the House endpoint local. The live alternative is that the eschatological timing passages should not color the ritual schedule.

changed_reading.before: The appointed term is a calendar date managed by the human beneficiaries.
changed_reading.after: The term is certain yet not theirs to accelerate or redefine; the local due arrival rehearses a wider pattern in which respite closes in an assured return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, the appointed term is named, God's name is voiced over provision, and the selected community is itself named and made witness. This changes مُّسَمًّى from a bare calendar label into one link in a public authorization chain joining time, offering, and accountable people.

activation_trace.role: Naming and designation anchor the focus term in the authorization chain.
Voicing remembrance on the tongue makes authorization audible in the rite.
The divine name is attached to the provision whose benefits the focus regulates.
Repeated naming joins the assigned rite to its authorizing name.
Naming over the sacrificial bodies marks their terminal handling as accountable action.
Selection and drawing near supplies the authorization of the human participants.
The community's explicit naming mirrors the focus term's designation.
Knowledgeable testimony assigns public accountability to the named community.

structural_cues: 22:28, 22:34, and 22:36 repeat God's name over provision and sacrificial bodies.
22:78 says the community was named and then assigns reciprocal witness roles.
The focus itself qualifies the term as مُّسَمًّى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated acts of naming over term, offering, and community; I infer a chain of authorization rather than mere lexical recurrence. The alternative is that اسم and مسمى perform unrelated grammatical jobs and should not be mechanistically joined.

changed_reading.before: The term is named only so participants can know when use ends.
changed_reading.after: The named term belongs to a wider regime of designation: time, offering, and witnesses are made publicly accountable under the name invoked over them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet's water-basin branch for أَجَل is form-distant from the ordinary temporal construction. It remains anchored in the focus's أَجَل and becomes materially coherent beside the surah's water-to-growth sequences. Downstream prose should present it only as a reservoir analogy for custody and release, never as a replacement lexical gloss for 'appointed term.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَجَلٍ at focus word 5, especially its packet branch of a basin that gathers water and then releases it to crops.

activation_trace.role: Benefit supplies what is accumulated and later released in changed form.
A basin gathering water before sending it to crops supplies the reservoir mechanism.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the released material.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the fructifying result of release.
Causing something to descend and arrive supplies the controlled input to the reservoir analogy.
Delivered water repeats the material that changes latent capacity into visible benefit.
Fresh green growth supplies the visible payoff of timed release.

changed_reading.before: The term is only a line on a calendar after which benefits stop.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the term behaves like a reservoir: it holds a field of benefit in custody until release redirects that stored usefulness into ritual and social fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because مَحِلّ is normally read through ح ل ل, while the packet also preserves a non-dominant ح ل ي mapping whose adornment branch is activated in 22:23. The reading remains packet-anchored at the focus word and yields a coherent transformation from utility into ritual beautification. It should be rendered as branch-induced wordplay or resonance, not as the lexical translation of مَحِلُّهَا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَحِلُّهَا at focus word 8 through the packet-supplied alternate mapped root root_000353.

activation_trace.role: Adornment and ornament supply an alternate transformational resonance for the focus endpoint.
Being adorned makes the branch image explicit elsewhere in the surah and activates the non-dominant focus mapping.
The House gives the proposed adornment a ritual center rather than a decorative end in itself.

changed_reading.before: The terminal phase merely relocates the useful object.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory resonance, arrival at the House converts bare utility into an adornment of the rite: usefulness is not destroyed but recoded as fitting beauty around the sacred center.

strongest_changes: The exact 22:5 construction turned the named deadline into a custody-maturation-release threshold.
The 22:25-29 sequence turned private benefit into witnessed, equal-access circulation and nourishment.
The falling and feeding sequence of 22:36, corrected by the reach contrast in 22:37, turned مَحِلُّهَا into a due event that converts use into distribution and piety.
The time and return grammar of 22:47-48 and 22:76 made the deadline certain but not beneficiary-controlled.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah became a compact switching mechanism rather than a static rule: temporary utility is held, marked, legally bounded, and then transformed at a protected House-centered threshold. The packet's split mappings also exposed live seasonal, emancipatory, reservoir, and adornment resonances without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact referent scope of فِيهَا and مَحِلُّهَا may be the sacrificial bodies specifically or the broader sign-complex.
مَحِلُّهَا can sustain both place-of-arrival and event-of-obligation; the context strengthens both without fully selecting one.
The و س م seasonal reading and ح ل ي adornment reading depend on non-dominant packet mappings and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The eschatological destination echoes may deepen the ritual itinerary without making the House endpoint identical to final return.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Temporary utility yields to an appointed release-point.** `ن ف ع B001` is benefit, `ء ج ل B001` an appointed limit, `س م و B005` named designation, and `ح ل ل B002/B004` settling and coming due; `ع ت ق B001/B003` supplies release and antiquity. The temporal marker *thumma* moves useful animals toward their due destination. I infer that benefit is legitimate precisely because it remains bounded by a named term and ritual end. The house reads as the point where temporary possession loosens into offering.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:58-59 unexpectedly generalized the term-and-destination pattern from animals to migrants: a bounded journey passes through death toward a satisfying entry.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Temporary utility is nested inside a sacred trajectory.** Fixed `مَنَافِع` activates `ن ف ع:B001`, `أَجَل` activates `ء ج ل:B001` (appointed limit), and `مُّسَمًّى` activates `س م و:B005` (fixed designation by name). After the temporal hinge `ثُمَّ`, `مَحِلُّهَا` activates `ح ل ل:B004` (coming due or falling upon) and `B002` (settling in a place), directed to the House of release (`ع ت ق:B001`). `22:32` names the animals as emblems and `22:34-36` specify their final ritual use. The packet supplies benefit, term, and due destination; I infer that ordinary use is authorized until the designated transition. Sacredness and utility therefore coexist in sequence rather than canceling each other.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `22:34-36` identify the due endpoint as a named offering whose body ultimately feeds different kinds of recipients. “Settlement at the House” therefore culminates in social circulation.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı, zararın karşıtı olan ve iyiliğe ulaşmada araçlık eden yarar çekirdeğiyle tanımlar; ayrıca birine yarar sağlama, bir şeyden yararlanma ve insanlara sürekli yararlı olma biçimlerini bu çekirdeğe bağlar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu ilişkileri doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın sınırı genel yarar çekirdeğidir; bir şeyden yararlanma ve yararlı kişi anlatımları bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, tek başına kullanılan yarar anlamını temel alır; birine yarar sağlama, bir şeyden yararlanma ve kişiyi niteleme biçimlerini ayrı, bağımlı yüzler olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Zararın karşıtı olan ve iyiliğe ulaşmayı kolaylaştıran olumlu sonuç ya da etkidir. Bu çekirdek, birine yarar sağlama, bir şey aracılığıyla yarar elde etme ve insanlara sürekli yararlı olup zarar vermeyen kişiyi niteleme biçimlerinde gerçekleşir.

facets.statement: Zararın karşıtı olan yarar, iyiliğe ulaşmada yardımcı olan olumlu bir sonuç veya etkidir.
Eylem yönü, yararın bir başkasına ulaştırılmasını veya o kişide yararlı bir sonuç doğurulmasını bildirir.
Belirli bir şeyle kurulan kullanım, kişinin o şeyden ya da onun aracılığıyla yarar elde etmesini bildirir.
Kişi niteliği olarak, insanlara sürekli yarar sağlayan ve onlara zarar vermeyen kimseyi anlatır.
Aynı yarar kavramı, kaynakta eşdeğer bir ad biçimiyle de ifade edilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği yararı zararın karşısına koyar ve onu iyiliğe ulaşmaya yardım eden şey olarak açıklar. Toplu kayıt, yarar verme, bir şeyden yararlanma, yarar adı ve başkalarına sürekli yararlı olan kişi nitelemesini aynı anlam alanında birleştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, derinin yarılmasıyla deri su kabının iki yanına yerleştirilen ve her yanda bir tane bulunan parçayı açıkça tanımlar. Verilen dal çerçevesi nesneyi, malzemeyi, yapım işlemini ve konumunu doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal su kabının tamamını değil, yarılmış deriden yapılıp kabın iki yanına ayrı ayrı konan yan parçalardan her birini adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, özel nesne adının tek başına taşıdığı anlamla sınırlıdır; tanıma başka kap adları, bakım işlemleri veya yapım bağlamları aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Derinin yarılmasıyla hazırlanan ve deri su kabının iki yanına, her yana bir tane olacak biçimde yerleştirilen yan parçalardan her biridir.

facets.statement: Parça yarılmış deriden yapılır ve deri su kabının iki yanından her birine bir tane yerleştirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adı aynı biçimde, deri su kabının iki yanında bulunan ve derinin yarılmasıyla hazırlanan parçalardan her biri için verir. Ortak anlatım hem parçanın malzemesini hem kabın yanlarındaki konumunu belirtir.

concept_gloss.text: deri su kabının iki yanındaki yarılmış deri parçalardan biri
concept_gloss.applicability: Özel nesne adının malzemesini, yapılışını, yan konumunu ve iki parçadan biri olmasını birlikte açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: Yarılmış deri malzemeyi, su kabındaki yan konumu ve her yandaki tek parça düzenini korur.

error_profile.loses: Yan parçayı ve parçanın deri yarılarak yapılmasını siler.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Birden çok parçanın birbirine dikilmesiyle oluşan kabın bütünü.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal konumu belirli tek bir yan bileşeni, komşu dal ise parçaları dikilerek oluşturulan bütün kabı bildirir; yapısal yakınlık nesne özdeşliği oluşturmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Su kabında belirli yere takılmış, işlevli ve tamamlanmış yan parça.

neighbor_distinctions.gloss: işlenmekte olan deri ile kap parçası
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak alanı deri malzeme ve onun işlenmesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal deriden yapılmış parçayı kabın yanındaki göreviyle tanımlar; komşu dal ise derinin işlenme aşamasını adlandırır ve su kabında bir konum gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Deri su kabının yapısına ait kalıcı yan bileşen.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dikiş deliklerini şişirip kapatmak ve sızıntıları bulmak için kaba su verme işlemi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi deri su kabının hazırlanması ve kullanılabilir duruma getirilmesi çevresinde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal somut bir yapısal parçadır; komşu dal ise kabın dikişlerini suyla sıkılaştıran bir bakım veya hazırlama işlemidir. Ortaklık yalnız aynı iş senaryosundadır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi adı doğrudan değnek olarak tanımlar ve kişiye bağlanan türemiş kullanımı değnek alıp satmakla açıklar. Verilen dal çerçevesi nesne çekirdeğini ve ona bağlı ticaret kullanımını birbirine karıştırmadan koruyabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği değnek adıdır; değnek alıp satmayı bildiren kullanım bu çekirdekten türemiş, kişiye bağlanan ayrı bir eylem yüzüdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel değnek adını çekirdek tutar ve kişiye bağlanan değnek alıp satma kullanımını ayrı bir türemiş yüz olarak belirtir; ticaret anlamı nesne adının tamamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bu dalın çekirdeği değnek adı verilen uzun, elde taşınan çubuk nesnedir. Buna bağlı türemiş kullanım, bir kişinin değnek alıp satmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Ad, elde taşınan uzun çubuk türündeki değneği bildirir.
Kişiye bağlanan türemiş kullanım, değnekleri konu alan alım satım işi yapmayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dalın kanıtı, nesne adını çekirdek; değneklerin alınıp satılmasını bildiren kişi kullanımını ise bu çekirdeğe bağlı türemiş bir yüz olarak ayırmayı gerektirir.

source_details.summary: Değnek adı ile değnek alıp satmayı bildiren türemiş kullanım birlikte tanıklanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın temel nesne anlamını doğal ve doğrudan karşılar; bağlı ticaret kullanımı bu genel ada katılmaz.

error_profile.preserves: Elde taşınan uzun çubuk türündeki temel nesne anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişiye bağlanan türemiş biçimin, değnek ticareti yapmayı bildirdiği eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Alınıp satılan nesnenin değnek olmasını ve kişinin bu işi yapmasını korur.
Uzun ve elde taşınan çubuk biçimini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Silah olma şartı taşımayan genel değnek kapsamını kaybeder.
error_profile.collision: Değneği sivri uçlu bir savaş veya av silahıyla karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın çekirdeği genel değnek adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek sınırında ayrım yoktur; odak daldaki alıp satma kullanımı bağımlı bir türeme olduğundan çekirdek eşanlamlılığını bozmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir oyuna veya kullanıma bağlı olmayan genel değnek.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir oyun parçasına vurmak için kullanılan özel tahta çubuk.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal elde tutulan uzun tahta çubuk türünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel değnek adıdır; komşu dal ise belirli bir oyunda başka bir parçaya vurmak için kullanılan özel değnekle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İtme veya hayvan sürme göreviyle sınırlanmayan genel değnek.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir yük hayvanını itmek, uzaklaştırmak veya vurmak için kullanılan özel değnek ve onunla yapılan eylem.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın nesne çekirdeği elde kullanılan değnek türünde kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal değneği görev sınırlaması olmadan adlandırır; komşu dal değneği hayvanı sürme, itme veya uzaklaştırma işlevine bağlar ve bu araçla yapılan eylemi de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uç, incelik veya silah işlevi gerektirmeyen genel değnek nesnesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnce dal, sivri çubuk, mızrak, uç ve çeşitli özel araç parçaları.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: değnek ile ince veya sivri çubuk
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Uzun ve dar çubuk biçimli nesneler iki dalın ortak bölgesini oluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel değneği bildirir; komşu dal incelik, sivrilik veya belirli araç ve silah görevleriyle ayrılan çubuk türlerini geniş bir kümede toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şey için belirlenmiş süreyi ve bu sürenin ölüm, borç veya benzeri bir konuda vardığı son zamanı birlikte bildirir. Belirli bir zamana erteleme ve sonraya bırakılmış olanın hemen gerçekleşene karşıtlığı da aynı zaman sınırı çevresinde yer alır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal neden bildiren kalıpları veya onay cevabını değil, süreyi, son zamanı ve zamana bağlı ertelemeyi kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın süre ve son zaman anlamını korurken ölüm, borç, belirli süre ve süre isteme gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şey için belirlenmiş sürenin kendisi veya bu sürenin vardığı son zamandır; ölüm, borç ve benzeri konularda zaman sınırını gösterir. Belirli bir zamana erteleme ile sonraya bırakılmış olanın hemen gerçekleşene karşıtlığı da bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey için belirlenmiş süreyi ve bu sürenin vardığı son zamanı bildirir.
Ölüm zamanı, borcun ödeme zamanı ve benzeri belirli zaman sınırlarında kullanılır.
Bir şeyi belirli bir zamana erteleme ve ertelenmiş olanı hemen gerçekleşenden ayırma anlamlarını kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, belirlenmiş bir sürenin hem uzanımını hem de son sınırını içerir; ölüm ve borç bu çekirdeğin başlıca gerçekleşmeleridir. Erteleme ve gecikmiş olanın hemen olana karşıtlığı da belirlenen zamana dayanır.

concept_gloss.text: belirlenmiş süre, son zaman ve o zamana erteleme
concept_gloss.applicability: Süreyi, sürenin son sınırını ve belirli bir zamana bırakma ilişkisini birlikte anlatan üst düzey karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirlenmiş süreyi, son zamanı ve erteleme bağını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir iş, yaşam veya yükümlülük için ayrılmış zaman aralığının öne çıktığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli zaman aralığı anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Son zaman ile erteleme ve gecikmişlik yönlerini tek başına açıkça göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Borcun veya başka bir yükümlülüğün yerine getirilmesi için belirlenen son zaman söz konusu olduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Belirlenmiş son zaman ve borç bağlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Ölüm ve genel süre kullanımlarını, ayrıca ertelemenin bütün kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: süre istedi, o da süre verdi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirlenmiş süre, erteleme ve hemen olana karşıtlık da bu dalın kapsamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyin genel son noktasını, yaşamın sonunu ve yarışın bitişini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir sürecin veya sürenin vardığı son sınırı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, zamanın önceden belirlenmiş süresi ve bu zamana erteleme üzerinde durur; komşu dal ise zamansal olmak zorunda olmayan genel bitiş ve son noktayı da içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şey için belirlenmiş sürenin tamamı, son sınırı ve erteleme ilişkisi yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Saat, an ve genel zaman parçası gibi belirli zaman bildirimleri de yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir iş için saptanmış zamanı gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal süre ile onun son sınırını ve ertelenmişliği bir arada taşır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise sürenin yapısını gerektirmeyen bilinen bir zamandır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar sınır bakımından değerlendirildi; en yararlı karşılaştırmalar genel son sınır ve belirli zaman dallarıyla kuruldu, öteki adaylar ya daha uzak alanlarda kaldı ya da aynı kökün açıkça ayrı dallarıydı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir eylemin hangi nedenle veya kimin yüzünden yapıldığını bildiren kalıpları açıkça bir araya getirir. Bazı kaynakların bunu kötülük işleme anlamına bağlayan köken açıklaması, güncel dal kimliğinin nedeni bildiren kalıp olmasını değiştirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca neden bildiren kalıpları kapsar; belirlenmiş süreyi ve bizzat kötülük işleme eylemini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, neden bildiren belirli edatlı veya eksiltili kalıplara bağlı tutulur; buradan yalın biçim için genel bir neden anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir eylemin yapılma nedenini veya eyleme yol açan kişi ya da durumu bildiren kalıp anlamıdır. Edatlı biçimlerin yanında edatın düşürüldüğü ve sesçe kısalmış kalıplar da aynı işlevi taşır.

facets.statement: Bir eylemin hangi nedenle ya da kimin yüzünden yapıldığını bildirir.
Neden ilişkisi edatlı, edatsız veya sesçe kısalmış birkaç kalıp biçiminde gerçekleşir.
Bir köken açıklaması, neden bildiren kullanımı bir şeyi işleme veya ortaya çıkarma düşüncesiyle ilişkilendirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu kalıpların yapılan işin nedenini veya o işe yol açan kişiyi bildirdiğinde birleşir. Biçim çeşitleri edatın korunması, düşmesi ya da sözün sesçe kısalmasıyla oluşur; köken açıklaması ise kullanımı bir şeyi işleme düşüncesine bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir eylemin sebebini ya da eyleme yol açan kişiyi bildiren bütün tanıklanmış kalıpların ortak karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Neden ile neden olan kişi veya durum ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Önceden anılmış bir olayın sonraki eyleme neden olduğu cümlelerde doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki durum ile sonuç eylemi arasındaki neden bağını korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir kişi için kullanılan yüzünden veya senin için yönünü açıkça göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin nedeni olarak karşıdaki kişinin gösterildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi eylemin nedeni olarak gösterme işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişi dışındaki nedenleri ve öteki biçim çeşitlerini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir eylemin nedeni kişi dışındaki bir olay veya durum da olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin değeri ve gönüldeki yeri anlamı da bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişinin bir eyleme neden veya dayanak oluşunu bildirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel neden kalıbıdır; komşu dal ise kişiyle ilgili neden kullanımını onun değer ve saygınlık anlamıyla birlikte taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gerçekleşmiş bir eylemin nedenini dil bilgisel bir kalıpla bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Birine kötülük işleme, kötülüğü sürükleme veya körükleme eylemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir köken açıklaması neden kalıbını bir şey işleme düşüncesine bağlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal artık neden bildiren kalıpsal bir işlev taşır; komşu dal ise doğrudan kötülük yapma veya ortaya çıkarma eylemidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; kişi kaynaklı neden dalı ile köken bakımından ilişkilendirilen kötülük işleme dalı sınırı en çok aydınlatan iki karşılaştırmadır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه من أجلك ومن إجلك ومن أجلاك وأجلك بلا من، وأجنك بمعنى أجل أنك، ومن أجل ذلك
